investigation: See docs/evidence/CLOUDS/M3-cost.md. The selected 2x2/3-local-sample arm is 73.892 ms versus 6.536 ms absent, under load averages 18.48 to 32.88. Trace 21.054 ms and compose 21.326 ms dominate the named cloud work; Sun paths total 1.923 ms, resolve 0.157 ms. Alternative refresh and light arms reduce measured work/cost without reaching refresh. A finer Sun candidate raises resource payload from 77,817,336 to 165,897,720 bytes without recovering the missing visual cue and is rejected. Capture-off costs are loaded tripwires, not quiet-device or physical cadence qualification. Sparse dispatch compaction, cached/prepared noise, and the compose pass break remain performance follow-ups; no unmeasured speedup is claimed.
estimates: CLOUDS DESIGN: weather <0.1 ms, Sun 0.1–0.2 ms, resolve 0.1–0.2 ms, compose 0.2–0.4 ms, total 47 MiB; trace measured here. One half-extent texel per 2x2 block refresh is 1/16 render pixels.
quality_observations: Selected refresh stride 2 (one quarter of half-extent texels, one sixteenth of render pixels) with 3 local Sun samples. The zero-local-sample still loses some surface relief and remains dull; three samples also fail bright sides. One-sample cost is recorded but no corresponding visual still was retained. Strides 1/2/4 were actually applied and their fresh-ray counts change as expected; fixed reset stills cannot judge their temporal quality.
